content: Long-running job pattern for FastAPI triggering CLI scripts: POST returns 202 + uuid job_id, work runs in background (sync-def BackgroundTasks run in a threadpool; async ones on the event loop), GET /jobs/{id} polls status stored in shared state. BackgroundTasks is in-process fire-and-forget: lost on crash/restart, no retries, no result store; Celery/RabbitMQ overkill for a single-user localhost wrapper. If the process must survive restarts, persist job records to a JSON file rather than an in-memory dict.
